judge.label: Fresh judge A
judge.nextAction: Add one approved, inspectable artifact to either WOWList or 196 / Sunday Dinner so a hiring reader can verify the operational and participatory continuity without relying mainly on summary prose.

hardGateNotes: Full repository checks and focused responsive QA passed for the working-tree candidate.
Exact-SHA approval and post-deployment production smoke remain open release-time gates.

dimensions.assessment: The repository makes the target hiring identity immediate: technical project manager, implementation lead, and technical operations / product operations translator-builder.
evidence: apps/www/src/app/page.tsx - 'Start here' routes the reader directly to role-fit proof.
apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx - the first paragraph names the role without hedging.

dimensions.assessment: The strongest inspected pages show Jamie doing translation, workflow design, implementation coordination, documentation, facilitation, and handoff work rather than merely stating values.
evidence: apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx - the operations map and proof map specify concrete actions.
apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx - the case states Jamie built the independent prototype and organized records into user pathways.
unresolvedRisks: WOWList and 196 / Sunday Dinner rely more on summary prose than on stepwise artifact evidence within the inspected files.

dimensions.assessment: The repository usually connects Jamie's work to something another person can actually use: guidance pathways, followable community surfaces, onboarding systems, decision logs, and durable handoffs.
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx - the outcome is a resident-facing pathway from source data to next steps.
apps/www/src/content/work/wowlist.mdx - the outcome is a followable keyword-based event distribution and discovery system.
unresolvedRisks: Some results are described persuasively but not always visually inspectable in the inspected content set.

dimensions.assessment: The public portfolio demonstrates range across civic technology, community platforms, cultural infrastructure, and small-business operations without losing the operating throughline.
evidence: apps/www/src/app/about/page.tsx - the domain list spans civic technology, small-business operations, public-facing tools, cultural infrastructure, coalition work, and knowledge systems.
apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx - the proof map names civic, cultural, community, and business contexts in one hiring surface.

dimensions.assessment: The pages are careful not to inflate authority; they show coordination, stewardship, facilitation, and implementation leadership more strongly than broad personnel-management power.
evidence: apps/www/src/app/work/technical-operations/page.tsx - the page emphasizes coordination across product, engineering, security, legal, communications, contracts, and external stakeholders.
apps/www/src/content/work/wowlist.mdx - the 'co-built' framing avoids unsupported sole-ownership or top-down authority claims.
unresolvedRisks: A skeptical employer looking specifically for formal line-management authority will still need other evidence beyond the inspected pages.

dimensions.assessment: The repository is notably disciplined about claims, boundaries, historical framing, and protected absences.
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/callnyc.mdx - the page repeatedly narrows what the evidence supports and includes an archive disclaimer.
apps/www/src/content/work/196-sunday-dinner.mdx - the page publishes only public-safe aggregates while withholding private participant data.
unresolvedRisks: Summary-only pages ask the reader to trust bounded prose where inspectable approved artifacts are still limited.
